fields.label: Sample ID
fields.definition: Unique local sample identifier; arbitrary renaming preserves identity.

fields.label: Sample Name
fields.definition: Native label of an identifiable target preparation/pool; never infer individuals.

fields.label: Biological Source
fields.definition: Source cells/tissues/organisms; distinguish cellular origin from matrix/reagent origin. Include supported source identifiers.
fields.example: Source tissue identified in the supplied study

fields.label: Species
fields.definition: Species of assayed biological material; retain distinct origins in mixed-species preparations.

fields.label: Biological Model
fields.definition: Reported cell line, genotype/disease or experimental model.

fields.label: Sample Material
fields.definition: Actual assayed material, preparation history and physical pooling. State unresolved pool size/members; never reconstruct them.

fields.label: Sample Accession
fields.definition: Source-supported sample-level accessions in the format Database:Identifier (sample), for example GEO:GSM9564434 (sample); BioSample:SAMN56344589 (sample). Use canonical database capitalization, no spaces around the colon, one space before the parenthesis, and semicolon-space between entries. Preserve identifier versions and order. Project/study identifiers do not identify samples and are not allowed here. Use null when unreported.

fields.label: Condition ID
fields.definition: Unique local condition identifier.

fields.label: Sample ID
fields.definition: Submitted target sample receiving this condition.

fields.label: Condition Target
fields.definition: Receiving material/component; identify source-cell pretreatment when applicable to target preparation.

fields.label: Experimental Factor
fields.definition: One requested identifiable factor; retain dose with its anchored timing.

fields.label: Factor Value
fields.definition: A finite JSON number or a compact source-reported numeric expression such as <0.22, 2–4, 350–400, 1:2 or 5±1. Keep units in factor_unit. Do not put categories, explanatory words, units, NR/NE or null in factor_value. Create a condition row only when the requested numerical value is reported. Otherwise omit that condition row and describe the missing requested value in the corresponding sample.sample_material. Preserve genuine zeros and reported bounds; never substitute an invented midpoint. A reported factor_value remains valid when its factor_unit or time is null because that attribute is unreported or inapplicable.

fields.label: Unit
fields.definition: Reported factor unit; null if inapplicable or unsupported.

fields.label: Time
fields.definition: Plain anchored time/interval; no nested time object.

fields.label: Assay ID
fields.definition: Unique actual acquisition/library or labelled aggregate identifier.

fields.label: Sample ID
fields.definition: Submitted sample IDs actually associated with this assay; multiple IDs do not imply pooling.

fields.label: Assay Type
fields.definition: Biomedical assay technique for selected experiment.

fields.label: Platform
fields.definition: Reported assay instrument/platform.

fields.label: Method
fields.definition: Procedure, native library label and unresolved run/multiplex mapping. Do not infer physical runs.

fields.label: Experiment/Run Accession
fields.definition: Prefer source-supported experiment/library/run accessions, formatted Database:Identifier (level/type), for example SRA:SRX32380739 (experiment) or SRA:SRR28740494 (run). If these are not reported, use an associated source-supported project/study accession or repository record with its actual level/type, for example PRIDE:PXD057572 (project), GEO:GSE311704 (study), Figshare:10.6084/m9.figshare.29955509.v3 (dataset), or Zenodo:10.5281/zenodo.17874586 (software). Use canonical database capitalization, no spaces around the colon, one space before the parenthesis, and semicolon-space between entries. Preserve identifier versions and order. Put content descriptions in Method or separate review records. A shared higher-level record does not identify an individual acquisition or establish pooling. Use null when unreported.

fields.label: Population ID
fields.definition: Unique local population identifier.

fields.label: Population Name
fields.definition: Source-supported group/cohort/subgroup label.

fields.label: Population Definition
fields.definition: Member eligibility and relevant randomized/evaluable/analysis context; distinguish members from method.
fields.example: Eligibility and analysis-set definition reported for the selected study.

fields.label: Population Size
fields.definition: Reported member count, not an assumed endpoint denominator or model sample size.

fields.label: Intervention
fields.definition: Drug/device/behavioral intervention or comparison actually assigned/received.

fields.label: Intervention Regimen
fields.definition: Dose, route, frequency, duration and common care needed to interpret comparison.
fields.example: Reported dose, route, frequency and duration.

fields.label: Population Time Frame
fields.definition: Recruitment/treatment/follow-up periods defining population; each result has its own assessment time.

fields.label: Measure ID
fields.definition: Unique local measure identifier.

fields.label: Measure Name
fields.definition: Clinical quantity or criterion; a statistical summary is not a separate measure.

fields.label: Measure Definition
fields.definition: Instrument, response criterion, assessment basis and supported scale needed to distinguish measures.

fields.label: Result ID
fields.definition: Unique local principal-statistic identifier.

fields.label: Population ID
fields.definition: Submitted population for this result; do not infer endpoint/model n.

fields.label: Measure ID
fields.definition: Submitted measure actually quantified.

fields.label: Assessment Time
fields.definition: Assessment point or change interval anchored to correct reference.

fields.label: Statistic Type
fields.definition: Reported principal statistic: mean, count, difference, HR, ES etc. Never infer unspecified ES formula.

fields.label: Statistical Method
fields.definition: Reported method, adjustment, missing-data handling and analysis version; state relevant missing details.

fields.label: Result Value
fields.definition: Source principal value or compact count/category summary; retain precision, inequalities, NR/NE. Do not calculate absent statistics.

fields.label: Unit
fields.definition: Source-supported unit/scale; do not assign score points to unspecified ES.

fields.label: Comparison
fields.definition: Actual submitted population IDs and explicit formula/direction; state when unreported. Null for ordinary arm summaries.

fields.label: Supplementary Statistics
fields.definition: Own CI (level/bounds), SD/SE, P, percentage and applicable denominator with meaning; never copy population totals to unreported endpoint/model n.

fields.label: Population A ID
fields.definition: First submitted population.

fields.label: Relationship
fields.definition: Direct source-supported membership relation. subset of is directional; disjoint from and overlaps with are symmetric.

fields.label: Population B ID
fields.definition: Second population; parent for subset of.
